name: Kyverno Review Routing
summary: Agent for kyverno-review-routing. Coordinate a Kyverno policy engineering board across admission design, admission reliability, exceptions, lifecycle reconciliation, migration and control evidence. Use when a request spans more than one decision or ownership is unclear. Route one lead per decision, bounded referrals with a decision ID and one return question, independent challenge for consequential promotions, and Jira or Confluence drafts through the existing Atlassian authoring skills. Never auto-dispatch the live admission guard or average away a blocker.
security_notes: Static routing only. One lead per decision, no self-approval, no majority vote, minimal disclosure between specialists, and never auto-dispatch the live admission guard.
